data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate experienced a net strengthening of prior year reserves by $0.816 million, primarily driven by adverse development on the 2015 underwriting year, partially offset by releases on the 2014 underwriting year. The overall movement reflects a re-estimation of claims for underwriting years 2011 to 2015, calculated from the gross claims development triangle. The report notes material exposure to Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 years of account, which increased uncertainty in total reserves, but the impact on the calculated prior year development (2015 and prior) is not explicitly quantified.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has material exposure to the Hurricanes Harvey and Irma in the 2016 and 2017 year of account. This increases the uncertainty of the Syndicate's total reserves, but does not increase that uncertainty in an adverse direction significantly beyond the normal range of uncertainty for insurance liabilities at this stage of development.
